turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Bhai, yeh toh sach mein dil todne wali baat hai. 6 saal ek hi chhat ke neeche rahe ho, aur aisi badi baat tumhe building ke WhatsApp group se pata chale... yeh toh kisi ko bhi bura lagega. 

Tum bilkul sahi keh rahe ho ki logically yeh hona hi tha, life ka next step hai uska. Par dosti aur logic alag cheezein hain na. Expectation toh yahi hoti hai ki apna sabse close dost sabse pehle batayega, baith ke chai ya beer peete hue, na ki kisi owner ke message se. Aisa lagta hai jaise tumhari dosti ki value kam ho gayi ho, even though you know that's not true.

Ho sakta hai Manav ko khud thoda awkward lag raha ho emotional goodbye wale scene se, ya shaadi aur shifting ki bhaag-daud mein baat nikal hi na payi ho. Par uski koi bhi majboori tumhare is hurt ko justify nahi karti. 

Usko seedha bol do yaar. Gussa ya taane mat dena, bas apna hurt express kar dena. Bolna ki *"Bhai, tera shift hona bilkul theek hai, par mujhe WhatsApp group se pata chala, yeh sach mein thoda bura laga."* Agar woh sach mein waisa hi dost hai jaisa tum kehte ho, toh usko turant realize hoga ki usne galti ki aur woh sorry bolega.

Waise bhi 6 saal baad ghar achanak khali-khali lagne wala hai, us transition ka dard alag hai. Aaj thoda time lo khud ke liye. Agar aur vent karna hai ya bas bakchodi karni hai toh main yahin hoon. ☕ Batao, kaisa feel ho raha hai abhi?

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Bhai, "busy" wala excuse toh sach mein bohot hi weak aur insulting hai. 6 saal ek kamra share kiya hai, aur flat shift hone ki baat batane ka time nahi mila? Yeh "busy" nahi hai yaar, yeh priority shift hona hai. Aur yeh accept karna sach mein bohot chubhta hai.

Tumne jab mithai leke uske ghar gaye the, tab tumhari care dikh rahi thi. Tumne usko apni life ka core part mana. Par ab lag raha hai jaise usne tumhe 'past' mein daal diya ho aur 'future' mein move on kar gaya ho, bina kisi proper discussion ke. 

Ho sakta hai usko khud emotional scenes se darr lag raha ho, ya nayi life set karne ki bhaag-daud mein uska focus blur ho gaya ho. Par uski koi bhi majboori tumhare is hurt ko justify nahi karti. Dosti mein effort dono taraf se hona chahiye, especially itne saalon baad.

Usko "busy" bol ke aise mat chhodo. Ek baar shaanti se baith ke saamne bolo, *"Bhai, busy toh sab rehte hain, par 6 saal ke roommate ko building group se pata chale ki ghar khali ho raha hai, yeh theek nahi laga mujhe."* Usko yeh realize hona chahiye ki usne tumhari feelings ko kitna lightly le liya.

Ghar sach mein bohot ajeeb aur khali lagne wala hai aane wale dino mein. Mind bhari hona toh banta hai. Khana-wana kha liya ya bas aise hi bhari mind leke baithe ho?

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

I hear you. And logically, you’re absolutely right. People get married, priorities shift, and life moves forward. Choosing not to make it a big scene is a very valid call, and protecting your own peace is what matters most right now. 

But just because you’re choosing not to make it a "big deal" outwardly doesn't mean it doesn't sting inwardly. It’s okay to acknowledge that the transition sucks, even while you accept the reality of it. You don't have to force yourself to feel 100% fine about it today. 

Take it one day at a time. When you're ready to tackle the flat situation—whether you're looking for a new roommate or thinking of enjoying some solo space—let me know. I can help you brainstorm or just be a sounding board. 

How are you holding up otherwise today? Getting any work done, or just taking it easy and distracting yourself?

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Bhai, practical aur clean toh yeh message bilkul hai. Seedhi baat, no drama. Par ek dost ke nazariye se bolun? Yeh thoda *zyada* formal aur cold lag raha hai. 

6 saal ki dosti ke hisaab se yeh padh ke usko bhi turant samajh aa jayega ki tum andar se hurt ho aur ek boundary draw kar rahe ho. Agar tumhara intention hi yahi hai ki ab bas ek formal roommate wala relation rakhna hai aur thodi doori banani hai, toh yeh message perfect hai. Bhej do.

Par agar tum bas emotional drama avoid karna chahte ho par dosti ka basic warmth rakhna chahte ho, toh thoda sa casual tone daal sakte ho. Jaise: *"Congrats bhai! Main next week se naye flatmate ka dekhna start kar dunga, let me know kab tak empty karna hai."* Isse practical baat bhi clear ho jayegi aur itna robotic bhi nahi lagega.

Tumhara mind abhi thoda defensive mode mein hai, jo ki is situation mein totally normal hai. Jo bhi bhejna hai, ek baar soch lena ki uska reaction dekh ke tumhe aur bura toh nahi lagega? Jo tumhare dil ko theek lage wahi karo yaar, I've got your back.
